svg.title: Professional Highlights & Core Specializations
svg.desc: Liquid Glass interactive dashboard showcasing Ajit Chowdary's 10+ years engineering expertise across Frontend, Mobile, Security, and API Automation.

g.text: Senior Web Developer & Mobile Application Developer with 10+ years of progressive experience engineering scalable,
resilient web platforms and high-performance cross-platform mobile apps. Proven track record delivering high-impact Fintech, Digital Bullion, & Proptech.
Modular architecture with standalone components, reactive forms,
and RxJS state management for high data-throughput portals.
Custom Angular Material theming, SCSS design tokens, Bootstrap,
Tailwind CSS, Slick Carousel, & AOS fluid entrance animations.
Automated Playwright test suites ensuring zero regressions across
critical multi-step investor onboarding & checkout journeys.
Clean Architecture with BLoC, GetX, and Provider across production
iOS and Android applications with a verified 4.5+ Play Store rating.
Declarative routing via GoRouter with authenticated route guards,
universal deep links, and Shimmer skeleton loading screens.
High-performance market tickers streaming live 24K gold, 999 silver,
& MCX commodities with dynamic TDS/GST computation formulas.
Biometric Local Auth (Face ID / Fingerprint), SMS autofill OTP
(Pinput), and seamless in-app DigiLocker Webview KYC onboarding.
PhonePe Gateway & Razorpay SDKs for Daily Savings Plans (DSP),
gold/silver installment EMIs, bullion store checkout, & wallets.
Flutter Secure Storage for encrypted tokens, automatic JWT session
renewal, and Syncfusion PDF Viewer for dynamic legal agreements.
Seamless consumption of Java Spring Boot RESTful microservices,
Swagger/OpenAPI contracts, and Firebase Cloud Messaging (FCM).
Dio networking layer with automated JWT token refresh interceptors,
request/response telemetry logging, and centralized error handling.
Automated APK build packaging with UiPath RPA, Dialogflow AI bots,
and rigorous QA defect triage resolving 200+ enterprise issues.
STATUS: PRODUCTION VERIFIED · DOMAIN: FINTECH & PROPTECH ECOSYSTEMS · BASE: HYDERABAD / VISAKHAPATNAM · ENGINEERING CADENCE: 10+ YEARS SCALE
